title.narrative: Zimbabwe SocioEconomic Transformation MultiDonor Trust fund

description.narrative:
"The objective of the Trust Fund is to promote economic stability and inclusive growth in Zimbabwe by strengthening the private sector to create jobs, improving public sector effectiveness and access to basic services, and building climate resilience. The Zimbabwe Socio-Economic Transformation Multi-Donor Trust Fund (""ZISET"") would also foster donor coordination. The objectives of the ZISET will be achieved through:
(i),,Strengthening the private and financial sector. (ii),,Improving public sector efficiency and basic services. (iii),,Building climate resilience."
